events.title: Midnight Souls is heading to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey!Steam Next Fest kicks off today, which means you can already hop into the Midnight Souls demo, check out new content, mechanics, and a whole lot more! Make sure to share your thoughts on the game, and if you wanna post your thoughts on social media, don’t forget to use #MidnightSouls so we don’t miss your posts. We really wanna see all ;)Also gotta mention that today you can play 4 more demos from Spaghetti Cat. They’re all different, but totally worth checking out:Brofish Going my way? Spin

events.title: A Message from Charlie
events.summary: While the game's developer was busy with... I took over the keyboard.I've got good news.Midnight Souls is part of the Cat Awareness Feline Sale!They told me to mention the event, the discounts, and all the other amazing cat games...But honestly? I only have one question.Have you wishlisted Midnight Souls yet?If not... I'll give you the disappointed cat stare.See you in Midnight Souls.— Charlie 🐾

Follow us on social media for updates and news: https://taplink.cc/dark_spaghetti_cat Game author Sergey Bolshakov and the Spaghetti Cat teamSee you in Camomile Peaks! ❤️

events.title: We're heading to the MGN Indie Game Carnival 2026!
events.summary: Big news, friends! Our game has been selected to take part in the MGN Indie Game Carnival 2026. All holiday week long, Midnight Souls will be in the spotlight alongside other cool indie games.Dates: April 30 through May 6.Head over to the festival page, find our game, watch the new teaser, and add it to your wishlist.
